description: Source code for tensor resize operations in PyTorch's ATen library, including functions for resizing tensors and storage, with support for different device types and memory formats.

methods.name: _resize_output_check
methods.description: Checks if tensor resize is necessary based on shape comparison.

methods.name: native_resize_
methods.description: Performs native resize on tensor with shape.

methods.name: _resize_output
methods.description: Performs resize if needed, avoiding redispatch for CPU and CUDA.

methods.name: resize_output
methods.description: Checks and performs resize for output tensor.

methods.name: resize_output_symint
methods.description: Resize output tensor with SymInt shape.

methods.name: resize_bytes_cpu
methods.description: Resizes CPU storage with memory copy if needed.

methods.name: resize_as_
methods.description: Resizes tensor to match another tensor, with optional memory format.

methods.name: resize_bytes_meta
methods.description: Resizes meta storage with new size.

methods.name: maybe_resize_storage_meta
methods.description: Resizes storage if size is larger.

methods.name: _maybe_resize_storage
methods.description: Dispatches storage resize based on device type.

methods.name: _resize_impl_
